**Status: in progress.** Working document of a multi-session round. The
session that works on the round keeps the status table in
"Packages and status" current and commits it after every package. Once
every package is done, this file moves to `docs/archive/`.

**Mockup (decision document):** https://claude.ai/artifact/WhyZNRNdXNuhxJJWivjyNz,
with a copy in the repo: `docs/mockups/design-audit-2026-10.html` (open it in a
browser; Latte/Mocha switch at the top). It shows each finding as a
real-app screenshot ("Heute") next to a live proposal built from the
app's own theme tokens.

**Decision (user, 2026-10-10):** implement everything as the mockup
recommends: row tinting variant **A** (only WARN and stronger tinted),
**rounded squares** for every action icon button with circles kept only
for the level filters, and a **new brand mark** (stacked log lines with a
filter funnel, as drawn in the mockup's C2) instead of the "L".

## Rules for whoever continues this round

- **Read only this file** plus the files a package names. Do not read old
  session transcripts; everything needed is here or in the code.
- Work as the lead per `.claude/skills/orchestrate/` (phases 3–5).
  Mockup and decisions are done, so start at phase 3. Each package goes
  to one `implementer` subagent (Sonnet, `run_in_background: true`), one
  at a time, because all of them edit `philogg.html`. Brief template:
  `orchestrate/delegation.md`. A package that still fails after two
  correction rounds goes to a fresh implementer with `model: "opus"`.
- **Verify every package yourself** (`orchestrate/verification.md`):
  diff review, `GROUP=<new group> npm test`, then real-app screenshots of
  the changed views in **both** themes (`--theme light` and
  `--theme dark`), compared with the mockup section named in the
  package. The README scene setup gives a ready-made filter tree:
  `--eval "$(cat docs/screenshots/scenes/common.js) <scene js>"` with data
  from `node tools/log-sim/cli.js -n 6000 --seed 7 -s all,-text,-gaps -o $S/app.log -q`.
  For pixel alignment (A1, A2), shoot a clip with
  `--size` and `page.screenshot` at a higher scale. If `screenshot.js`
  can't express it, extend `screenshot.js` (e.g. a `--scale` option)
  instead of writing a private script.
- **Commit after each verified package** on the branch
  `claude/design-quality-polish-p3vk7i` (`feat:` for visible changes,
  `test:`/`docs:` otherwise; no Claude attribution lines, see
  CLAUDE.md), update the status table below in the same commit, then
  push. The full suite (`cd tests && npm test`) runs before every commit
  that touches code; `SHARDS=8` only in `finish` at the end.
- **Docs per package:** one shared changelog fragment
  `changelog.d/2026-10-10-design-polish.md` (each package extends it, it
  stays 3–6 lines overall), `docs/ui-standard.md` for the new tokens and
  button rules (P1, P4, P6, P8), and the matching `docs/ui-and-views.md`
  section for view changes. Run `node scripts/doc-toc.js` after changing
  Markdown.
- **No new dependencies, no font files.** System UI font, as today.
- **All themes:** the app has many themes beyond Latte/Mocha. Use tokens
  and `color-mix()` derived from existing tokens, never literal colors in
  rules, so every theme and custom theme keeps working.

- **Learned in P1–P6** (put these into every brief):
  - `tools/log-sim/screenshot.js` has `--scale <n>` and `--hover <selector>`.
  - Some tests parse the per-theme `:root[data-theme="…"]{…}` blocks textually, so new theme overrides go inside the existing `light` / `catppuccin-latte` blocks, never into a combined top-level selector.
  - `tests/groups/354-homepage-site.js` probes the CSS comment `Version tag (PHILOGG_VERSION) as a pill`, so don't reword it.
  - Tokens added so far: `--hairline` (P1), `--btn-hover` and `--bg-popover` (P4); popover rule and `.ctx-danger` (P6).
  - Header separators are pseudo-elements on `#navHistoryGroup` / `#hdrHistory` (P5).
  - Tree guides: only vertical `.tree-guide.v` segments, `TREE_INDENT_STEP` 18, `TREE_CHEVRON_CENTER` 7, no middle-cut labels (P7).
  - Global `select` / `input[type="checkbox"]` rules (P8): restyle a select with `background-color` only (the chevron is a `background-image`); a hidden checkbox (e.g. `.settings-switch input`) must set its own width/height. `<option>` text can't be styled per span.
  - Formatters (P9): `formatCount` (de-DE grouping), `formatAxisNumber(v, asMs)` (compact SI / durations, axis labels only), `formatPlotValue` (exact, tooltips and stats), `plotColIsMs(ci)`. A `t (ms)` X axis is drawn as clock time (`plotXIsClock`), not as a duration.
  - Plot (P10): `niceTimeTicks(lo, hi, target, base)` for clock/ms axes, `.plot-grid-line.v` dashed, `area` mark op for single-series lines, no `plotAxisCaret` any more.
  - Minimap (P11): overlay is one SVG `<path>` per level (`.minimap-ov-bar.minimap-lvl-*`), per-level counts in `minimapOvLevels` (bucket × `MINIMAP_RANKS`); a rect per segment tripled render time.
  - The empty start screen can't be shot with `screenshot.js` today, because it requires a log file. P12 should add a way.

## Usage budget, pause and handover (binding)

Follows `.claude/skills/orchestrate/usage-budget.md`, made concrete for
this round:

1. **Before every package:** read the budget (`get_session` without ID →
   your session ID; `list_events` on it with
   `kinds: ["rate_limit_event"]`, `limit: 100`, newest entry →
   `unifiedWindows.five_hour` / `seven_day`). Start the package only if
   `five_hour.utilization + estimate ≤ 0.85` and
   `seven_day.utilization < 0.90`. Estimates are in the table below.
   Write the reading in the "Budget log" at the end of this file (one
   line) in the package's commit.
2. **Measured values:** note the five-hour utilization before and after
   each package in the status table (column "Used"). If two packages in a
   row are off by more than half, correct the remaining estimates in this
   file.
3. **Next package doesn't fit, or your own context is above ~250k tokens**
   (`get_session` → `external_metadata.context_usage.used_tokens`): start
   no new package. Instead:
   1. Make sure everything verified is committed and pushed; an
      unverified half-done package is committed as `WIP: P<n> <name>`
      (unprefixed) with a line in the status table saying what is done
      and what is missing.
   2. Update the status table and the "Budget log", commit and push.
   3. Start **one** fresh session with `create_session`
      (`source_url: https://github.com/Sarrdai/PhiLogg`,
      `source_revision: claude/design-quality-polish-p3vk7i`,
      `model: "claude-opus-5-5"`, title
      `Design-Polish Orchestrator (Fortsetzung <n>)`) and exactly the
      start prompt from "Start prompt for a continuation" below, with
      `<RESET>` replaced by `five_hour.resetsAt` + 5 minutes as UTC
      RFC3339 (or "now" when the budget is fine and only the context
      was too large).
   4. Tell the user in one short German message: which packages are done
      (commits), which session continues, when it continues (local time
      Europe/Berlin), and that this session can be archived. Then stop.
      Do not resume work in this session.
4. **The continuation session** only arms its timer in its first turn
   (`send_later` at `<RESET>`) and ends that turn without reading files,
   so it spends almost nothing before the reset. When the timer fires,
   it reads this file and continues with the first package whose status
   is not `done`.
5. **Last package done:** run the `finish` skill (merge current `main`,
   `SHARDS=8` full suite, docs check, push, no PR), move this file to
   `docs/archive/` with the status line set to implemented, regenerate
   the README pictures (P13), and report to the user in German with
   before/after screenshots.

```
Wenn der Timer feuert: git pull origin claude/design-quality-polish-p3vk7i,
lies docs/ui-concept-design-polish.md vollständig und arbeite nach
dessen Regeln (Budget-Prüfung vor jedem Paket, ein Implementer pro
Paket, selbst verifizieren mit Screenshots in beiden Themes, nach jedem

oder dein Kontext nicht mehr, übergib genau so, wie die Datei es
beschreibt, an eine neue Session. Antworte dem Nutzer auf Deutsch.
```

## Findings → rules (what "done" looks like)

Section names (A1 …) match the mockup.

- **A1 Level counters** (`.level-btn .level-count`, CSS around line 1689,
  count text from `levelCountShort()` around line 24190): UI font
  (`var(--font-ui)`) with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`, 10.5px,
  weight 650, `line-height:1`; digits optically centered with
  `text-box: trim-both cap alphabetic` and a fallback for browsers
  without it (`@supports not (text-box: trim-both cap alphabetic)` →
  `transform: translateY(.06em)`); ring 1.5px instead of 2.5px (the inset
  box-shadow); `levelCountShort` drops a trailing ",0" (3058 → "3k",
  1738 → "1,7k"); `.level-count-long` no longer shrinks to 8.5px. Checked
  by a screenshot at ≥3× scale: the digit's vertical center is within
  0.5 CSS px of the circle's center. Desktop tier only; phone/compact
  tiers keep their chips.
- **A2 Level badges** (`.level-badge`, line ~2525, colors ~2688): one
  shared badge, `display:inline-flex; align-items:center;
  vertical-align:middle`, height 17px, UI font 10px weight 650,
  letter-spacing .04em, fill 14 % of the level color (was 22–28 %), text in
  the level color. TRACE gets enough contrast to read. The same look in
  Filtered/Context rows, Patterns ("Max level"), Link view and the entry
  detail header. Badge center = row center (screenshot check).
- **A3 Number formats:** one helper for counts (`toLocaleString("de-DE")`
  like the rest of the app). Fix the export dialog (`#exportSummary`
  ~48253, the "Lines" buttons, the export header ~48161: "6000" →
  "6.000"). Plot axis numbers (`formatAxisNumber` ~26201) stop switching
  to exponent notation below 1e9 for integers and use compact SI
  ("100k", "1,5M") instead; an axis whose field is a millisecond time
  (`t (ms)`) is labelled as a duration ("1m", "2m 30s"); the colorbar
  label uses the same formatter.
- **B1 Column dividers** (`.col-resize-handle` ~1916): invisible 8px hit
  area with a centered 1px `--hairline` line from 8px top to 8px bottom;
  hover/drag → 2px `--accent` line. No grey block at rest.
- **B2 Hairline token:** new `--hairline` in `:root` derived per theme:
  `color-mix(in srgb, var(--border-soft) 55%, var(--bg-app))` (light) /
  45 % for dark themes, defined once so custom themes inherit it. Every
  pure separator uses it: row separators, panel edges, toolbar bottom
  borders, table cell borders, menu separators, tree guides. `--border`
  stays for input/button outlines. Document both in
  `docs/ui-standard.md` → "Design tokens".
- **B3 Row tinting, variant A** (`.log-row` ~2292, level classes
  `.lvl-*`, selection ~2302/3867): INFO/DEBUG/TRACE rows get no fill;
  WARN ~6 %, ERROR/FATAL ~7 % of the level color; one 3px level stripe
  flush at the left edge (no second outer marker stripe, no rounded
  ends), DEBUG stripe at 45 % opacity; selection =
  `color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 16%, var(--bg-app))` plus an inset
  1px accent outline, keeping the level stripe visible. Bookmark/find
  markers that used the outer stripe must stay recognizable (move them
  into the stripe or a small dot in the gutter, whichever is less
  disruptive: check what the outer stripe encodes before removing it).
  The user-defined highlight colors of filter nodes keep tinting rows
  as today (they are the user's choice, not level tinting).
- **B4 Filter tree** (`.tree-row` ~842, `.tree-guide` ~878–893): guides
  1px in `color-mix(in srgb, var(--border-soft) 75%, var(--bg-panel))`,
  no horizontal stubs; 18px indent per level; the expand chevron gets its
  own 14px column, and the line to a node's children starts right below
  that chevron; the existing accent path to the selected node stays, as a
  1.5px accent line and accent-colored ancestor names; names truncate at
  the end with "…" (full name in the tooltip) instead of the middle
  "..." cut; hover icons replace the count instead of overlapping it; the
  level-filter "three dots" icon becomes the regular filter icon (the
  colored dot already says "level"). Mockup B4 has the live three-level
  example.
- **C1 Toolbar button language** (`.row-action-btn` ~1379,
  `.row-action-btn.rect` ~1385, `.add-badge` ~1225, view tabs
  `.view-tab` ~4949): every action icon button 28×28, radius 6px, no
  border and no fill at rest; hover = 8 % text color; active toggle =
  `--accent-soft` fill + accent icon (replaces the teal underline);
  disabled = opacity .38. The filled grey squares (Bookmark/Note/Check)
  become the same ghost buttons. The `+` add badge: solid accent disc
  with a 2px ring in the background color, never translucent. The view
  tabs (Patterns/Context/Filtered/Table/Plot) become a segmented control
  with a raised active segment (`--bg-popover` fill and a small shadow).
  Level filter buttons stay circles. The hover labels that grow out of
  the buttons keep working (their radius follows the new shape).
- **C2 Header** (`.brand` ~458, header buttons around HTML line 6418):
  new brand mark (inline SVG: accent rounded square, three stacked
  lines, small funnel; see mockup C2), version as a small pill next to
  the name instead of under it, header buttons as ghost buttons like C1,
  undo/redo as one group, a hairline separator between groups. If the
  app sets a favicon, it uses the same mark. Desktop app icons are out
  of scope.
- **C3 Native controls:** `<select>` in dialogs, plot panel and settings
  get `appearance:none`, UI font, an SVG chevron, height 32px,
  `--border-soft` outline, `--bg-popover` fill; data-type suffixes like
  "(int)" are shown in tertiary color where the option text is built in
  JS. Checkboxes in the plot Y-axis list (and other remaining native
  checkboxes in lists) get a custom 16px box: `--border` outline,
  checked = accent fill with a check mark in `--accent-on`. Keyboard and
  screen-reader behavior stay native (style the real input, don't
  replace it).
- **C4 Segmented groups:** export "Lines" and "Format" and the settings
  "Theme" mode become one connected segmented control
  (`.assert-mode-btn` family or the C1 tab style, per
  `docs/ui-standard.md`); "Save file ▾" gets the chevron icon instead
  of the text triangle.
- **D1 Popovers:** new token `--bg-popover` (light themes:
  `color-mix(in srgb, #fff 55%, var(--bg-app))`, dark: one step above
  `--bg-elevated`'s base, derived with `color-mix` from `--bg-app` and
  `--text-primary`), 1px `--hairline` border, a two-layer shadow,
  radius 9px, items 30px high, shortcut hints right-aligned in tertiary
  color, destructive items ("Remove filter", "Delete …") in
  `--level-error` with an error-soft hover. Applies to the menus at
  ~5433 (`#contextMenu, #treeContextMenu, #openMenu, …`), the help menu,
  the library menu, the filter popup `#filterPopup` (~5229) and the
  find bar.
- **E1 Minimap** (`renderTimelineMinimap` ~33681, bursts ~33999): bars
  stacked per level in proportion (INFO/DEBUG/TRACE muted with
  `color-mix` toward the background, WARN/ERROR/FATAL full strength)
  instead of one bar colored by its worst level; burst flags clamped
  inside the minimap (no clipping at either edge); the stat line above it
  in UI font with only the values in mono and the level counts as small
  color squares; the "Bursts" chip as its own pill that no longer
  touches the stat line. Performance: keep the render cost of today
  (one pass over the buckets); measure with a 1M-line file if the
  render path changes (`docs/performance-testing.md`).
- **E2 Extraction table** (`#extractTable` ~3427): numeric columns
  right-aligned with tabular digits; column width from content instead of
  stretched; type chip ("ms", "int") right next to the column title, sort
  arrow right after it.
- **E3 Plot axes** (`niceTicks` ~26187, time axis ticks): time ticks on
  round values (whole minutes/seconds, not "first sample + 50s"), grid
  1px `--hairline` with dashed verticals, axis titles in UI font without
  the tiny ▾ marks (keep whatever control they open reachable, e.g. on
  the title text itself), line plots get a light area fill under single
  series. Heatmap and scatter colorbars use the A3 formatter.
- **E4 Detail panel empty state** (`#detailPlaceholder` ~7278): with no
  selected row the panel shows only its tab bar with the hint right-
  aligned ("Select a row to see its full message"); it opens on the
  first row selection. In Table/Plot it no longer shows a stale entry
  with "This entry is not part of the current filter" unless the user
  selected that entry there.
- **E5 Start screen** (`#emptyState` ~2740): a drop zone (dashed
  `--border-soft`, radius 14px) with "Open files…" (primary) and
  "Open folder…" buttons wired to the existing open actions, one line of
  text, shortcut hints as `<kbd>` keys; the text no longer refers to an
  "Open…" button that doesn't exist.

Status values: `open`, `running`, `done`, `wip` (committed half-done,
see note), `blocked` (with a reason in the note).

Tests per package: a new group file `tests/groups/design-polish-<pkg>.js`
with its `group("design-polish-<pkg>");` marker that asserts the
decisive CSS rules (via `document.styleSheets`, like
`tests/groups/drawer-header-tap.js`) and any JS behavior (formatters,
tick values, DOM structure of tree guides, badge markup). Existing
groups that assert the old look are updated, not left green on dead
rules.
